ns2:course.label: Introduction to Playwriting
ns2:course.description: Practical course in writing for the stage, including a study of basic dramatic construction and the analysis of weekly writing assignments, focusing on structure, style, and imagination, and culminating in a final term project of a one-act play. Prerequisite: THEA 208 or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: THEA 208 or consent of instructor.
